name: Swatch
doc: A fixed palette from hex colours (a text param: '#ff71ce #01cdfe ...', 2 to 8 of them). Style packs use it. Optionally cycles along the stops on the beat or with the pads' palette step.

colors.doc: 2-8 hex colours, separated by spaces or commas

cycle.doc: steps along the stops per bar

pads.doc: the pads' D-pad palette step rotates it too
